## Frequently asked questions

### Where is MCC Catering?
No. 49, South Bazaar, Thandurai, Pattabiram, Chennai 600 072 (Proprietor: +91 99403 96005 · +91 95516 39651).

### What facilities does MCC Catering have?
Wedding catering, Engagement & reception, Corporate events, Housewarming, Banana leaf meal service, Festival & special occasions, Live counters, Executive packed meals, Custom menus, Free sample tasting for weddings.

### Do you offer a sample tasting?
Yes, a free sample tasting for weddings and engagements.

### What packages do you offer?
Silver, Gold and Premium feasts, or a custom saapadu menu. Pricing is per person and the final quote depends on menu, guest count and season.

### How do I check if MCC Catering is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99403 96005.
